description: Labeled search queries. Relevance is a SQL rule over structured fields, written without looking at any retriever's output. Columns: title, brand, category, category_path, norm (title + details, upper-case, non-alphanumerics removed, for part numbers).

queries.query: Zelda Breath of the Wild Switch
queries.where: title ILIKE '%breath of the wild%' AND category = 'Video_Games' AND (title ILIKE '%switch%' OR category_path ILIKE '%Nintendo Switch%')
title ILIKE '%elden ring%' AND (regexp_matches(lower(title), 'ps5|playstation 5') OR category_path ILIKE '%PlayStation 5%')
title ILIKE '%animal crossing%' AND title ILIKE '%new horizons%'
title ILIKE '%red dead redemption 2%' AND (title ILIKE '%xbox%' OR category_path ILIKE '%Xbox%')

title ILIKE '%dualsense%' AND title ILIKE '%controller%' AND NOT regexp_matches(lower(title), 'charg|skin|cover|grip|case|stand|dock|holder|thumb|cap|decal|sticker|faceplate|shell|replacement|button|cable|mount')

regexp_matches(lower(title), 'switch.*oled|oled.*switch') AND regexp_matches(lower(title), 'console|system|model') AND NOT regexp_matches(lower(title), 'case|protector|skin|dock|stand|grip|cover|charg|bag|sticker|decal|mount|strap')
category_path ILIKE '%Refrigerator%' AND regexp_matches(lower(title), 'door') AND regexp_matches(lower(title), 'shelf|bin')
regexp_matches(category_path, 'Oven|Range') AND regexp_matches(lower(title), 'bake element|baking element|heating element')
category_path ILIKE '%Nintendo Switch > Accessories%' AND regexp_matches(lower(title), '\bcase\b')
regexp_matches(lower(title), 'headset') AND (regexp_matches(lower(title), 'xbox one') OR category_path ILIKE '%Xbox One%')
regexp_matches(lower(title), '\bmouse\b') AND regexp_matches(lower(title), 'rgb') AND NOT regexp_matches(lower(title), 'pad|mat\b|bungee|skates|feet|grip tape')
regexp_matches(lower(title), 'mechanical') AND regexp_matches(lower(title), 'keyboard') AND NOT regexp_matches(lower(title), 'keycap|switch puller|wrist rest|cover')
regexp_matches(lower(title), '(vr|virtual reality) headset') AND NOT regexp_matches(lower(title), 'case|strap|cover|lens|stand|charg|cable|holder|mount')
regexp_matches(lower(title), 'handheld') AND regexp_matches(lower(title), 'retro|emulator|classic') AND regexp_matches(lower(title), 'console|game player|game system')

queries.query: stop the drinking water from my fridge tasting like chlorine
replacement rubber band that turns the clothes dryer drum
mesh insert that catches cooking grease above the stove
small machine that makes cubes for drinks at home
queries.where: category_path ILIKE '%Ice Makers%' AND NOT regexp_matches(lower(title), 'scoop|bag|mold|tray|filter|part|replacement|valve|motor|assembly|kit')

queries.query: keep my bottles of red and white at cellar temperature
the rubber strip around my fridge door is torn and lets cold air out
the little wheels fell off the bottom basket of my dishwasher
coil at the bottom of my oven stopped glowing
queries.where: regexp_matches(category_path, 'Oven|Range') AND regexp_matches(lower(title), 'bake element|baking element|heating element')

queries.query: dials to turn the burners on my stove
refillable pod so my single-serve brewer can use my own ground coffee
one machine that both washes and dries clothes
queries.where: category_path ILIKE '%Washers & Dryers%' AND regexp_matches(lower(title), 'combo|all.in.one|washer.{0,3}dryer|washer and dryer')

queries.query: big box to store frozen meat in the garage
steering setup for driving simulator games
keep two gamepads topped up overnight
protect the portable console's display from scratches
headphones with a microphone for online shooters
queries.where: regexp_matches(lower(title), 'headset') AND category = 'Video_Games' AND NOT regexp_matches(lower(title), 'stand|holder|hanger|cushion|ear pads|earpads|cable|adapter|mount')

queries.query: goggles you wear for immersive 3D gaming
queries.where: regexp_matches(lower(title), '\bvr\b|virtual reality') AND regexp_matches(lower(title), 'headset|goggles|glasses') AND NOT regexp_matches(lower(title), 'case|strap|cover|lens protector|stand|charg|cable|holder|mount')

queries.query: blocky survival sandbox game where you mine and craft
cozy island life simulator with talking animal neighbors
